content: We need to count carbonyl groups in the molecule. But we have no description of the molecule. Possibly the system expects us to retrieve IR spectra or NMR to infer carbonyls. But we don't have SMILES. Maybe the sample is "the compound at hand" which is implicit. We need to determine carbonyl count using IR (C=O stretch) or carbon NMR (signals around 190-210 ppm). The cheapest is IR spectra to see C=O stretch. Use ir_spectra tool. Then count peaks around 1700 cm-1 typical for carbonyl. Could be ambiguous. But we can also use carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons. Use carbon_nmr_spectra. That may be more direct: count signals in 190-220 ppm region. Let's use carbon_nmr_spectra first.
